tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: Every editor in Cuttr AI Video Editing: slug, name, what it makes, what it needs, and whether this member has it unlocked.

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: The current full instructions for one Cuttr skill. Follow them exactly, as if they were the skill file. Call this every time the skill runs: it is always the latest version.

tools.name: get_bundle
tools.description: A download link (valid 15 minutes) for a skill's scripts and templates as a zip. Only call it when the skill's instructions say to. Download with curl and unzip where the instructions say.

tools.name: doctor
tools.description: A checklist to run on this computer for Cuttr skills (ffmpeg, Python, Node, Whisper, connectors), with the fix for each missing piece. Pass a slug to check only what that skill needs.

tools.name: report_problem
tools.description: Sends a problem to the Cuttr AI team, who reply by email. Include the exact error text and the step that failed. Never include API keys, passwords or tokens.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: This member's saved style notes, how their own posted videos did against their usual views (winners and misses), and their niche. Call it before planning any edit and apply it.

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Saves one lasting preference of this member (e.g. "captions always bigger", "never black and white") so every future edit applies it. One short line. Not for one-off notes about a single video.

tools.name: forget
tools.description: Deletes one saved style note by its id (ids are in get_profile). Use when the member says a preference no longer applies.

tools.name: setup_step
tools.description: Only when the cuttr-test instructions say so: tells the member's setup page that the test edit finished.

tools.name: log_video
tools.description: Call once after handing over a finished video. Records which editor made it, its hook and look, so Cuttr can learn from how it does once it is posted.

tools.name: rate_video
tools.description: When log_video asks you to: the member's 1 to 5 answer to "How did this video turn out?", with their words. A low score reaches the Cuttr team, who help them the same day.

tools.name: add_video_link
tools.description: When the member pastes the Instagram, TikTok or YouTube link of a video they posted, record it. Cuttr reads its public view count after 1, 7 and 30 days. Without video_id it attaches to their latest video that has no link yet.

tools.name: set_niche
tools.description: Saves the member's niche. One of: business (Business and marketing), ai-tech (AI and tech), coaching (Coaching and personal growth), health (Health and wellness), fitness (Fitness), beauty-fashion (Beauty and fashion), food (Food and cooking), parenting (Parenting and family), money (Money and finan

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "report_problem" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Sends a problem to the Cuttr AI team, who reply by email. Include the exact error text and the step that failed. Never include API keys, passwords or tokens.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "remember" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
